extDesc.message: A web proxy for one browser tab. When a page will not open, TrickyBird fetches it for you and opens it in that tab.

badgeAttention.message: Click the TrickyBird icon to see what happened with this tab.

popupLaunchHeading.message: Nothing on this page to open

popupLaunchBody.message: Browser pages and files on this computer cannot be opened with TrickyBird. Our site takes an address and opens it for you.

popupLaunchHelper.message: It opens in a new tab. This one is left as it is.

popupFirstRunBody.message: TrickyBird is a web proxy. It fetches the site for you, so the request to the site goes out from our server, not from your browser. The page then opens here, in this tab.

popupFirstRunTradeServers.message: Our servers fetch the page, rewrite its links before you see it, and get what you type or send there.

popupFirstRunTradeAddress.message: The address bar shows an address of ours, not the site’s. Sometimes it is just numbers.

popupFirstRunTradeCookies.message: That site’s cookies stay on our server, not in your browser, so you may need to sign in again.

popupFirstRunTradeRequest.message: We get the address first, even if the page fails to open.

popupIdleHelper.message: This tab goes to our site, then one more press opens the page. Stopping later is one click.

popupOfferLinkBody.message: TrickyBird fetches it through our servers and opens it in this tab.

popupOfferFailedBody.message: Your browser couldn’t reach $SITE$. TrickyBird can try fetching it through our servers and opening it in this tab instead.

popupRoutedHelper.message: When you stop, the page reloads straight from the site. Closing this tab stops it too.

popupStaleHeading.message: This page didn’t come from TrickyBird

popupStaleBody.message: TrickyBird is set up for this tab, but the page in front of you was not fetched by us. Loading it again goes through TrickyBird; stopping leaves the tab as it is.

popupFailedCopied.message: Copied. Paste it into your message to support.

errNoSessionBody.message: Something went wrong while TrickyBird was setting this tab up.

errNoSessionHelper.message: Try once more. If it happens again, copy the details below and send them to support.

errUnreachableBody.message: TrickyBird’s site did not answer the extension, so nothing was opened.

errUnreachableHelper.message: Trying again is safe. If it keeps happening, this network may be blocking TrickyBird, and our status page says whether the trouble is on our side.

errNotRoutableBody.message: TrickyBird only opens ordinary web pages. This one belongs to the browser itself, or its address is inside your local network.

errNotRoutableHelper.message: Open the site you want in this tab, then click the TrickyBird icon.

errTabGoneBody.message: This tab went somewhere else before TrickyBird finished, so nothing was changed.

errTabGoneHelper.message: Go back to the page you wanted, then try again.

errExpiredBody.message: This launch waited a long time for a press, so TrickyBird let it go.

errExpiredHelper.message: Try again to open the same address.

optionsRoutedEmpty.message: No tab is going through TrickyBird right now.

optionsRoutedEmptyHint.message: Open a page in a tab, then click the TrickyBird icon in your toolbar.

optionsAutoRecoverLabel.message: When a page fails to load, offer to open it with TrickyBird

optionsAutoRecoverHelp.message: A red mark appears on the TrickyBird icon in your toolbar. Click the icon and TrickyBird offers to fetch that page. Nothing opens unless you choose it.

optionsAutoRecoverPermission.message: Chrome will ask to read your browsing history when you turn this on. It is the narrowest permission that can tell a page failed, and TrickyBird uses it only to notice the failure and to clear the offer once a page loads.

optionsEndpointHelp.message: TrickyBird starts here, and moves to another of its own addresses if this one stops answering. Change it only if someone gave you a different address.

optionsEndpointInvalid.message: That needs to be an https address with nothing after the host.

optionsAccessDenied.message: TrickyBird didn’t get the permission it asked for, so your changes were not saved. Press Save again to see the request once more.

popupHandoffHelper.message: The address is already in the field on that page. Press Open there to continue, or cancel and nothing is sent.

popupOnSiteHelper.message: Put an address in the field on this page and TrickyBird opens it here, in this tab.

popupExpiredHelper.message: TrickyBird is no longer holding the address this tab was sent here with. Put it in the field on this page to start again.
